answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to submit an R1CS satisfiability proof binding a scarce stake to a unique nullifier, acting as a bridge between pseudonym and collateral. Static analysis of under-constrained signals flags forged witnesses, letting honest nodes treat verified proofs as an oasis of trust while a raven-like auditor detects. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
